description: soapbar before 8daaf221: verify_envelope_bsp trusted the message-embedded certificate — attacker-signed SOAP envelope passes verification. Verbatim fail-closed guard: forged envelope accepted on vuln, rejected on fixed
vuln_description: soapbar is a SOAP library for Python — client, server, and WSDL handling. Prior to version 0.13.0, verify_envelope_bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken, validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify_envelope_bsp() therefore proved only that the envelope was signed by whoever supplied the embedded certificate — never that it was signed by a trusted party. An attacker who mints their own certificate, signs a forged envelope, and embeds that certificate in the token passes verification. name: Log4j2-CVE-2021-44228

An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled. Note that this vulnerability is specific to log4j-core and does not affect log4net, log4cxx, or other Apache Logging Services projects.

description: PHP <8.2.36/8.3.37/8.4.28/8.5.13: php_log_err_with_severity formats local time during module startup — use-after-free of uninitialized DATEG(tzcache) on ZTS. Verbatim flag selection from cb20015e^ vs fix: unsafe localtime on vuln, UTC on fixed
vuln_description:
Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution.

In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-133968
description: MONAI Label <=0.8.5: image IDs/label tags concatenated into datastore write paths with no confinement — ../ traversal gives arbitrary file write/RCE (CISA KEV). Verbatim _confine_path from 113527b^ vs fix: /etc/cron.d/pwn write on vuln, rejected on fixed
vuln_description: monailabel (aka MONAI Label) through 0.8.5 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.

name: CVE-2026-29000_PoC
description: CVE-2026-29000 PoC Token Generator
vuln_description: pac4j-jwt versions prior to 4.5.9, 5.7.9, and 6.3.3 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in JwtAuthenticator when processing encrypted JWTs that allows remote attackers to forge authentication tokens. Attackers who possess the server's RSA public key can create a JWE-wrapped PlainJWT with arbitrary subject and role claims, bypassing signature verification to authenticate as any user including administrators.

name: CVE-2026-48751
description: LXD: snapshot restore re-applies config without project restriction validation — raw.lxc/raw.qemu hooks bypass restricted.containers.lowlevel=block (RCE). Verbatim guard from 6b93b2a0^ vs fix: restricted config restored on vuln, blocked on fixed
vuln_description: Incus is a system container and virtual machine manager. Prior to version 7.2.0, instance snapshots ignore the `restricted.containers.lowlevel=block` setting; allowing for arbitrary command execution on the Incus server by abusing lowlevel hooks such as `raw.lxc` and `raw.qemu`. Version 7.2.0 patches the issue.

name: CVE-2026-133780
description: Symfony stimulus-bridge: Stimulus magic comments evaluated with node:vm.runInNewContext — arbitrary code execution at build time. Verbatim VM path from 25f1ff0^ vs literal-only AST parser: marker set on vuln, rejected on fixed

name: CVE-2026-30940
description: baserCMS 5.2.3 incomplete patch: theme path boundary check skipped when realpath() fails — '../../webroot/webshell.php' accepted for write (RCE). Verbatim PHP guards from c650017^ vs complete fix: traversal on vuln, rejection on fixed
vuln_description: baserCMS is a website development framework. Prior to version 5.2.3, a path traversal vulnerability exists in the theme file management API (/baser/api/admin/bc-theme-file/theme_files/add.json) that allows arbitrary file write. An authenticated administrator can include ../ sequences in the path parameter to create a PHP file in an arbitrary directory outside the theme directory, which may result in remote code execution (RCE). This issue has been patched in version 5.2.3.

name: CVE-2026-115375
description: Incus <7.0.2/7.5.0: dependent volume names from a backup index used as path segments without validation — '../escape/pwned' creates a volume outside the pool. Verbatim IsAPIName guards from f7b57f4^ vs fix: traversal path on vuln, rejection on fixed
vuln_description: Incus 7.0.0 before 7.0.2 and 7.1.0 before 7.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows clients able to create instances to write files on the host. The flaw stems from unvalidated dependent custom volume names in instance backup index.yaml files. Attackers can import a crafted instance backup with ../ sequences in dependent volume names to create root-owned directories with controlled content, leading to full host compromise.

name: patched_ptero
description: Patched Java Docker images for Pterodactyl Panel (CVE-2026-114938 / Java4Shell) — multi-arch, auto-built to GHCR

Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511b33-perf, 17.0.21.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 27.0.1.0.3; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.3 and  21.0.13.0.3; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.3.
